decisions.notes: The lead vehicle brakes in-lane while ego decelerates from about 5 m/s to a stop. The automatically selected minimum-TTC actor is a different Lincoln approaching continuously from the rear after ego stops; its motion was verified in rgb_back and agrees with BEV. Accepted as a multi-view longitudinal-response event, not as a collision or closed-loop improvement result.

After the preregistered terminal-tail and complete-window guards, the selected actor is a stationary same-lane Dodge about 18.9 m ahead, continuously visible in front/BEV; a separate vehicle merges from the left T-junction and exits view normally. The majority-stopped warning is retained. Accepted only as a route-geometry/task-relevance hard negative pending keyframe geometry preflight, not as a severe safety event.
